incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: pd-4456 inference-gateway - alert=5xx-rate (threshold 2%)
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: pd-4456 triggered · paging on-call · escalation policy: inference-sre · notified: @Alex K.
Alex K.: acked. i’m on it. checking logs + grafana. no runbook handoff yet.
Maya S.: quick look — grafana shows a ~30s spike in 5xxs from router pool A, p95 latency blips too. link: https://grafana.internal/r/inf-gw/alerts?from=now-5m
Alex K.: no obvious deploys. running curl against health endpoints, all 200.
Alex K.: running tail on gateway logs: ```
[2024-11-16T12:34:09Z] inference-gateway router-a ERROR: upstream timeout (x2)
[2024-11-16T12:34:10Z] inference-gateway router-b WARN: kv-cache miss, warming
[2024-11-16T12:34:11Z] inference-gateway router-a INFO: request served 200 in 78ms
```
Maya S.: looks like short kv warmup on a subset of routers. traced a small regen of cache keys. not systemic.
Priya L.: FYI customer-facing SLOs show no increase in user-facing errors (slo-dashboard ok).
incident-bot: PagerDuty: pd-4456 auto-resolved (no further escalation)
Alex K.: confirmed alert auto-resolved. sounds like transient warmup. no rollbacks or config changes.
~40s later~
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: pd-4460 triggered · inference-gateway · similar 5xx spike detected
Alex K.: ugh — another short burst. acked again. checking correlation.
Maya S.: both bursts align with a background job that recomputes embeddings on node set A. I see a short CPU bump on those pods.
Alex K.: temp mitigation: disabling that job is possible, but prefer to observe a bit more — these are <60s blips.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: pd-4460 auto-resolved
Priya L.: no customer tickets. ops metrics show requests succeeded on retry. likely harmless but noisy.
Jon P.: i’ll file a follow-up ticket to adjust alerting window and add kv-warmup to runbook. assigning to eng-runtime.
Jon P.: ticket: RW-INC-3821 created — summary: flapping brief 5xx spikes from kv-cache warmup; propose increase alert window to 90-120s + add runbook steps
Maya S.: runbook link: /runbooks/inference-gateway/kv-warmup (needs a note about background job throttling)
Alex K.: thanks — gonna monitor next 1h. if it flaps again we can throttle the background job.
Priya L.: good plan. also recommend we adjust PD suppression to avoid double pages for <30s bursts.
Alex K.: noted. handoff to Jon for follow-up. @Jon P. take it? :point_right:
Jon P.: taking it. will coordinate with runtime team tomorrow.
Alex K.: resolved for now. marking no customer impact and logging follow-up. :white_check_mark: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Thread closed (no active pages)
